sloka: कस्यचित् तु अथ कालस्य कुशनाभस्य धीमतः ।जज्ञे परम धर्मिष्ठो गाधिः इति एव नामतः ॥१-३४-५॥
transliteration: kasyacit tu atha kālasya kuśanābhasya dhīmataḥ ।jajñe parama dharmiṣṭho gādhiḥ iti eva nāmataḥ ॥1-34-5॥

translations.english: After some time, a supremely righteous son by name Gadhi was born to the sagacious Kusanabha.
